english.title: Keeper of equine fail to provide necessary information to issuing body to complete ID
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), failed to provide to the issuing body all information necessary to allow the body to complete an existing ID for the purposes of Article 15(2) of EU Regulation 2015/262, subject to Article 15(3) of that Regulation, so that it complied with the requirements of Article 7(2) in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7, 24(2) and 36 of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 37(1) provides that an enforcing authority may impose a civil sanction, or a combination of civil sanctions, under Part 6 against a person if the authority is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person is guilty of this offence.
(ii) Regulation 37(2) provides that criminal proceedings may not be started or continued against a person if any enforcing authority, in respect of the offence, chooses to apply civil sanctions and services a compliance notice, non-compliance penalty notice or fixed monetary penalty notice on that person.
